title: Origin AI coding platform challenges GitHub post-outage
description: Origin, the new AI-powered code hosting platform launched by Cursor—recently acquired by SpaceX for $60 billion—is positioned as a cutting-edge alternative to GitHub. Origin addresses the growing complexity of managing multiple AI agents collaborating on code simultaneously, a situation GitHub’s traditional human-centric design struggles to handle effectively. By integrating code storage, pull requests, and AI agent interactions into a unified workflow, Origin streamlines development processes. AI agents automatically read repositories, apply changes, create pull requests, and push branches without manual intervention, allowing developers to review, test, and merge seamlessly within Cursor’s environment. This innovation responds to the evolving demands of AI-assisted coding and marks a significant shift in software development infrastructure. #Origin #CursorAI #SpaceX #GitHubAlternative #AICoding #CodeHosting #SoftwareDevelopment #AIAgents #PullRequests #TechInnovation #CodingTools #DevOps #AIProductivity #ProgrammingPlatforms #AIIntegration
